segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick check on Northline. They want the renewal quote by Friday, 74 seats, same support tier, term starting March 1.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. Are they asking for any expansion or just flat renewal?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Flat renewal, but they want the invoice split quarterly instead of annual. Their finance lead said annual is a nonstarter this year.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Did you already run pricing?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I did. It was kind of a grind, honestly — I had to enter the same 74 seats, March 1 to Feb 28 dates, 8% discount, and quarterly billing in the CRM, the pricing sheet, the deal desk intake, and then again in the billing tool before I could get the proposal PDF out.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Yeah, that tracks. Is deal desk okay with the 8%?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They approved it this morning. No redlines on terms, just the billing schedule note and the auto-renew language stays at 30 days.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Good. Who signs on their side, still Dana?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Dana signs, but she wants procurement copied. I’m sending to Dana and Marcus, with the PO field left blank until they issue it.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Perfect. If they push on go-live timing, remind them there’s no implementation work, it’s just keeping access live on March 1.
